```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load Packages
```{r}
pacman::p_load("dplyr", "Seurat", "glue", "stringr")
```

# Load Data
## Load Sensitivity 5 Seurat Object
```{r}
seu_obj_duodenum_singlets <- readRDS("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-1-Duodenum_Singlets_seu_obj.RDS")
```

# QC
## 1. Add percent.mt
```{r}
seu_obj_duodenum_singlets[["percent.mt"]] <- Seurat::PercentageFeatureSet(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets, pattern = "^mt-")
```

# QC Plots
## 1. Violin Plots
```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=16}
Seurat::VlnPlot(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3) %>% print()

if (!dir.exists("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-2-Output/")) {dir.create("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-2-Output/", recursive = T)}

pdf("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-2-Output/Duodenum-QC-Vln-Plots.pdf", height = 12, width = 16)
Seurat::VlnPlot(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3) %>% print()
dev.off()
```

## 2. Feature Plots
```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=16}
plot1 <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- Seurat::FeatureScatter(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")

a <- plot1 + plot2
a

pdf("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-2-Output/Pool-2-QC-Feature-Scatter-Plots.pdf", height = 12, width = 16)
a %>% print()
dev.off()
```

## QC Table
```{r}
dplyr::count(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets@meta.data, nFeature_RNA > 1000, HTO_maxID)
dplyr::count(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets@meta.data, nFeature_RNA < 6000, HTO_maxID)
dplyr::count(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets@meta.data, percent.mt > 10, HTO_maxID)
```

## Subset by QC-cutoffs
Min Features = 1000
Max Features = 7000
Min percent.mt = 10
```{r}
seu_obj_duodenum_singlets_clean <- subset(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets, subset = nFeature_RNA > 500 & nFeature_RNA < 6000 & percent.mt < 20)
```

Final Counts Table by Hashtag
```{r}
table(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets_clean@meta.data$HTO_maxID) %>% as.data.frame()
table(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets@meta.data$HTO_maxID) %>% as.data.frame()
```
```{r}
seu_obj_duodenum_singlets_clean@meta.data
```

# Save RDS
```{r}
saveRDS(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets_clean, "../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-2-Duodenum_Singlets_clean_seu_obj.RDS")
```

```{r}
seu_obj_duodenum_singlets_clean <- readRDS("../../output/deodenum-analysis/Step-2-Duodenum_Singlets_clean_seu_obj.RDS")
```

```{r}
table(seu_obj_duodenum_singlets_clean$HTO_classification)
```
